facts.business: Times Green Energy (India) Limited manufactures natural organic fertilizers through agri-waste management, sanitary napkins and other women's hygiene products, and operates an e-commerce platform Bazaartimes.in across Agriculture, Women Hygiene and E-commerce verticals.
